# EMFLS Finance, Tax & Utility Calculators

> Free interactive calculators and verified 2026-2027 tax, social insurance, salary, and government benefit guides across Korean, English, and Japanese.

## Korean Finance & Utility Calculators

- [단리, 적금, 할부 계산기](https://emfls.github.io/kor/util/fin-calc/): Compound interest, loan repayment, and savings calculator hub in Korean.
- [복리 vs 단리 계산기 (월 불입 포함) — 복리 vs 단리 계산기 (월 불입 포함) 계산](https://emfls.github.io/kor/util/compound-interest/): Interactive compound interest growth projection calculator in Korean.
- [해외주식 양도소득세 계산기 2026 | emfls](https://emfls.github.io/kor/util/overseas-stock-tax-calculator/): Korean overseas stock capital gains tax (22%) and 2.5M KRW deduction calculator.
- [퇴직연금 수령 시나리오 비교기 | 세전 월 수령액 예시](https://emfls.github.io/kor/util/retirement-pension-withdrawal/): Korean retirement pension (IRP/DC/DB) withdrawal and tax calculator.
- [자동차검사 비용·예약 도우미 | TS 수수료 기준 확인](https://emfls.github.io/kor/util/car-inspection-cost/): Korean official vehicle inspection fee (TS Korea Transportation Safety Authority) estimator.
- [보조배터리 Wh 변환·기내반입 확인기 | mAh·전압 계산](https://emfls.github.io/kor/util/power-bank-wh-calculator/): Airline cabin carry-on power bank mAh-to-Wh capacity checker.
- [정수기 렌탈 가격 비교 계산기 | 약정 총비용 확인](https://emfls.github.io/kor/util/water-purifier-rental-price-comparison/): Long-term water purifier rental vs purchase total-cost comparison calculator.
- [한국어 계산기·유틸리티 전체 허브](https://emfls.github.io/kor/util/): Complete directory of Korean financial, tax, and everyday utility tools.

## Korean 2026-2027 Tax, Benefit & Government Guides

- [건강보험료 납부확인서 인터넷 발급(2026): 정부24 무료·PDF·팩스](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/2026-health-insurance-premium-payment-certificate.html): How to issue National Health Insurance payment confirmation PDF/fax free online.
- [소득금액증명원 홈택스·정부24 PDF 발급 | 2026 무료·귀속연도 확인](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/2026-income-certificate-hometax-gov24-pdf.html): How to issue official income certificate via Hometax and Gov24 in PDF.
- [2026 생애최초 주택 취득세 감면 조건 한도｜200만·300만 원 차이](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/first-home-acquisition-tax-relief-2026-200-300-childbirth-500.html): 2026 first-home acquisition tax exemption limits (2M/3M KRW and childbirth 5M KRW).
- [2026 에너지바우처 신청 마감·잔액조회｜12월 31일·연간 최대 701,300원](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/energy-voucher-2026-application-deadline-701300-bokjiro-balance.html): 2026 Energy Voucher support amounts up to 701,300 KRW, deadline, and balance lookup.
- [신용점수 무료조회 NICE KCB 차이 (2026) | 각사 연 3회·조회 영향](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/credit-score-free-check-nice-kcb-difference-no-impact-2026.html): Free NICE and KCB credit score checking without impacting credit rating.
- [휴면예금 숨은돈 찾기 조회·청구 2026 | 찾아줌 2,000만원·어카운트인포 1,000만원](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/dormant-deposits-kinfa-accountinfo-claim-inheritance-2026.html): Unclaimed dormant deposits and insurance payout lookup via KINFA and AccountInfo.
- [4대사회보험 가입내역서 가입자명부 발급 2026 | 개인 비회원·사업장 구분](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/four-major-social-insurance-enrollment-certificate-pdf-history-2026.html): 4 major social insurances enrollment certificate PDF issuance and history lookup.
- [2026 인감증명서·본인서명사실확인서 인터넷 발급: 정부24 무료·방문 600원](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/2026-seal-certificate-gov24-online-offline-issue.html): Seal certificate vs electronic signature confirmation online/offline issuance guide.
- [2026 현금영수증 자진발급 등록 010-000-1234 | 홈택스·손택스 준비물 3가지](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/2026-cash-receipt-self-issued-consumer-registration-hometax-sontax-0100001234.html): Registering self-issued cash receipts (010-000-1234) on Hometax and Sontax.
- [사업자등록증명 무료 발급 2026 | 홈택스·정부24 PDF 저장](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/business-registration-certificate-hometax-gov24-pdf-2026.html): Free business registration certificate PDF download via Hometax and Gov24.
- [2026 기본증명서 인터넷 무료 발급｜일반·상세·특정 차이와 자녀 PDF](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/basic-certificate-online-free-general-detailed-specific-minor-2026.html): Free online issuance of Korean Basic Certificate (general, detailed, specific).
- [2026 대형폐기물 인터넷 신고·스티커 수수료 | 스마트클린 관악·프린터 없을 때](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/bulky-waste-disposal-guide-2026.html): Korean municipal bulky waste online disposal permit and fee schedule guide.
- [2026 신용·체크카드 분실신고 | 어카운트인포 일괄신고·60일 보상 조건](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/card-loss-one-stop-report-reissue-60day-2026.html): One-stop lost credit/debit card suspension via AccountInfo and 60-day dispute rules.
- [2026 생활·세무·정부지원금 전체 안내](https://emfls.github.io/kor/report/gov/): Directory of 120+ verified Korean tax, social insurance, and civil document guides.

## English Finance & Business Calculators

- [Simple Interest, Savings, Installment Calculator](https://emfls.github.io/util/fin-calc/): Interactive loan, compound interest, and savings calculator hub.
- [Compound vs Simple Interest Calculator (with Monthly Deposit)](https://emfls.github.io/util/compound-interest/): Compound interest growth calculator with recurring contributions.
- [Loan Payment Calculator – Monthly Payment & Interest](https://emfls.github.io/util/loan-payment-calculator/): Monthly loan amortization and interest breakdown calculator.
- [ROI Calculator – Return on Investment](https://emfls.github.io/util/roi-calculator/): Return on investment (ROI) and annualized return calculator.
- [Break-even Calculator – Units and Revenue](https://emfls.github.io/util/break-even-calculator/): Fixed and variable cost break-even unit and revenue calculator.
- [Profit Margin Calculator – Margin and Markup](https://emfls.github.io/util/profit-margin-calculator/): Gross margin, markup percentage, and unit profit calculator.
- [Commission Calculator – Commission and Total Earnings](https://emfls.github.io/util/commission-calculator/): Tiered sales commission and payout rate calculator.
- [Hourly Salary Calculator – Weekly, Monthly, Annual Pay](https://emfls.github.io/util/hourly-salary-calculator/): Hourly-to-annual and salary conversion calculator.
- [EMFLS English Calculators & Web Utilities](https://emfls.github.io/util/): Directory of free client-side English financial and productivity calculators.
